label: Portage / Orangedale-Iona road crossroads
phase: Fresh expansion of unchanged affine4 validation; no fitting or model-selection use
point_definition: Centre of the legacy road crossroads at Portage, not the nearby highway junction.
identity_evidence: The source labels Portage or Matheson at the narrow land corridor between Whycocomagh Bay and the channels toward Denys Basin. The west road reaches a north-south route and an eastward branch at the same compact crossroads. The original reference retains the legacy Portage Road meeting with Orangedale-Iona Road and Farghers Lane. The nearby Highway223 alignment east of this site is distinct and not substituted for the old junction. The peninsula, channels and branch order corroborate the location.
